description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to check an existing report for compliance issues such as missing business purpose or policy violations. Creating a report, excluding Personal expenses, sharing a report, or billing a client is not a compliance request; never call this tool automatically as a preflight or follow-up for those workflows.

userRequest.description: The user's exact request explicitly asking for compliance, policy, audit, substantiation, or business-purpose analysis. Do not paraphrase or invent intent.

name: check_compliance
